//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> First Join Message -> Config

Enable First Join Message.//: Whether First Join Message is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

firstJoinMessage.//: The message players will receive when they join a world for the first time. To disable, leave it empty. %s can be used in place of the player name.
firstJoinMessage.value: Здравствуй, путник. Если ты потерялся, то можешь открыть Книгу Квестов слева сверху.

firstJoinMessageTextFormattingColourInde.//: The colour of the message. The possible values are; 0: black, 1: dark_blue, 2: dark_green, 3: dark_aqua, 4: dark_red, 5: dark_purple, 6: gold, 7: gray, 8: dark_gray, 9: blue, 10: green, 11: aqua, 12: red, 13: light_purple, 14: yellow, 15: white. min: 0, max: 15

serverBroadcastMessage.//: A message that's broadcasted to the server when a player joins for the first time. To disable, leave it empty. %s can be used in place of the player name.
serverBroadcastMessage.value: Добро пожаловть в этот можетбыть не очень добрый мир

serverBroadcastMessageTextFormattingColo.//: The colour of the message. The possible values are; 0: black, 1: dark_blue, 2: dark_green, 3: dark_aqua, 4: dark_red, 5: dark_purple, 6: gold, 7: gray, 8: dark_gray, 9: blue, 10: green, 11: aqua, 12: red, 13: light_purple, 14: yellow, 15: white. min: 0, max: 15
